balls.text: Top edge falls short of the boundary! Short and angled across again, he looks to pull and it goes off the top edge. Vyshak does well to track it, dive and keep it in and they manage to run two. Bawa caught ball-watching a bit at the end but Santner manages to call him back for the third! And now PBKS need 204 to get to the final
200 up for MI! Length ball angled across him, he looks to pull it away but gets a top edge that lands in the vacant mid-on region and they do well to scamper for two
Back of length slower ball, Santner is early into the pull and is hit on the body with the ball dropping to his left. They take a leg bye. That was an offcutter from Omarzai

Oh, he's hit that straight to extra cover! Goes for the wide yorker again, but it's just short of yorker length. Dhir looks for the lofted inside out drive but can't get the elevation on it and Stoinis grabs it above his head. That wicket could mean MI leave a few runs out there
Omarzai nails the wide yorker and Dhir can only squeeze it out to mid-on. Sends Bawa back immediately
Dhir starts off strong! Fetches this full ball from outside off and swipes it over midwicket and well straight of deep midwicket running to his left
Looks for that leg stump yorker, Dhir is able to ease it out to deep midwicket for a single that will give him the strike next over
In the slot outside off and punished! Dhir hits a lofted drive down the ground and straight of mid-off!
Another edge lands safe! Short outside off and Bawa makes a mess of the pull but it drops in that vacant square leg region
Full outside off, Bawa looks to drive and it goes off the inside half of the bat between long-on and deep midwicket. They get two with ease
Yorker outside off, Dhir gets his bat down to jam it out to mid-off for a single
Dhir nails the pull! Short on leg, he stands tall and finds the gap in front of square!

And Omarzai gets the MI captain! How big a blow is that?! Slower bouncer outside off and Pandya has an ungainly swipe at it and the top edge goes straight up. Inglis settles under it and gives Omarzai his first wicket on the night
Low full toss outside off, Dhir punches it on the bounce to long-off

Prabhsmiran's first contribution is to concede four! It's a short ball angled into Dhir, who eases a pull behind square. Prabh at deep square leg moves to his right and gets his hands down to collect the ball but it just goes under the fingers!

Top edge lands safe! Dug in short outside off at 120kph. Pandya goes for the pull but mistimes it. The ball balloons up to land in the square leg region but it was too far for short fine leg to run across and grab
Good comeback by Omarzai, going for the wide yorker. It's a full toss in the end but Hardik can't get bat on it
Hardik has waited and waited and now says enough is enough! Length ball outside off, Hardik clears his front leg and slaps it away wide of long-off!

Oh no, what have you done, Arshdeep? It was such a good over until now, despite the two edged boundaries. But now Arshdeep puts it too full outside leg and it's easy pickings for Dhir, who just clips it in the gap behind square leg
Brute of a bouncer there! Banged in on leg at 133kph, it seams away and Dhir has to duck and get his head away even as he shaped to swivel and pull
ON a length on leg, tapped into the midwicket region for a single
Short on leg and this time angled across him slightly, Dhir stands tall to pull it out to deep square leg
Action replay of the last ball! Short on leg, he swivels to pull and gets enough on it again to clear short fine leg. He got more bat on this than the last one though
Dhir gets lucky! Cramped for room and deceived by the lack of pace on this short ball, he swivels and looks to pull. Gets a top edge but it has enough to go over short fine leg and race away for four

Taps this full ball into the vacant midwicket region and goes for two. And oh wait, PBKS are gifting MI runs there! Deep midwicket comes in and collects and has a throw at the non-striker's end. The throw is wayward and even Shashank Singh at cover can't stop it and it goes away for four!
On a length outside off, Pandya defends
On a length outside off, Pandya opens the face to steer it to backward point
Short ball around off, he swivels and pulls it out in front of deep square leg. 150 up for MI
Full ball outside off, Dhir sees mid-off up in the circle and looks to go down the ground. Doesn't get enough on it and Shreyas is able to pull it back before it reaches the boundary
Goes for the yorker around off, not quite full enough and Hardik is able to squeeze it out past backward point
Full outside off, Pandya steers it down to deep third. Jamieson finishes with a four-run over and a big wicket. Great spell from the Kiwi quick!
On a length outside off and angling in, Hardik brings out a front foot defence
Runs this full ball down to deep third
Back of length outside off, Hardik steers it towards short third for a single
On a length outside off, fended behind point. There is a misfield and that allows them to run a single

Tilak falls and PBKS have two quick wickets! Slower ball, full outside off. Tilak gets down on one knee to try and go downtown and ends up skying it straight down. Mid-off and mid-on were converging and it's Priyansh Arya running to his right who judges it perfectly and holds on. MI lose two set batters in a space of three balls!
Pandya decides to play Chahal out. Floated full around middle and off, Pandya watchfully defends under his eyes

Chahal gets his man in the end! This one, full on middle, goes on with the arm. Suryakumar goes for the sweep but gets it off the toe end and it's gone straight to Nehal Wadhera at deep midwicket! Big, big moment in the context of the game
Lofed down the ground and it lands on the boundary cushion! Or was it just short? Clears his front leg and goes straight down the ground
On a length outside off and spinning away, SKY looks to sweep and gets an under-edge onto the ground. Inglis deflects it to short third as he tries to collect
Bludgeoned down the ground! Not quite a slot ball outside off but SKY picks the leg break, frees his arms and smashes it back over Chahal
Tossed up on middle, Tilak lofts it back over his head. Only gets a single though as long-on comes across
Not this time, says Suryakumar Yadav! Another slower short ball outside off, SKY is quickly across and pulls it in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg
Another slower bouncer deceives SKY as he is early into the pull. Good stuff from Jamieson!
Slower bouncer outside off and SKY can't hit that as he looks to hook it but holds back on the shot at the last second
Full outside off, SKY looks to go across the stumps and play that trademark scoop, but misses out. Cops a blow on his midriff
Slower bouncer outside off again, and SKY again reaches out and this time he gets enough on it to loft it over backward point
Back of length outside off, SKY has to reach out to try and cut that but the slower ball deceives him. Goes off the edge on the bounce to backward point
Full outside off, eased to long-off
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, whipped away to deep midwicket's left for a single. That takes SKY to 25 for the 16th T20 in a row!
Floats up a low full toss on leg but Tilak can only tuck it out to deep midwicket
Full outside off, swept out to deep midwicket

That's just too far for long-off! He gets his hands on it but can only palm it over the rope! Jamieson was running to his right and leaps with his arms at full stretch above his head, but it was jus too high for him! This is tossed up outside off and Suryakumar lofts it straight down the ground, to long-off's right

Oh, brilliantly played all around! Omarzai nails the yorker on off and Tilak does very well to drill it out in front of square leg. But Nehal Wadhera runs across, dives and manages to stop the boundary! Rolls over the ball but stops it from going through to the boundary! Excellent fielding
Length ball angled across, Suryakumar just clips it in the vacant square leg region for a single
Full outside off, Tilak looks to slog it away but gets it off the inside half of the bat to long-on along the ground
Tilak goes across his stumps early and this time Omarzai pulls his length back. Tilak gets a bottom edge as he looks to cut

Reaches out wide and scythes it away! Omarzai goes for the wide yorker but it's only a full toss. Tilak stretches and slaps it away. Shashank Singh put in a dive to his right at the boundary, but can't stop it
Chips it down the ground and it falls safely with long on and deep midwicket converging! This was full outside off and he looked to loft it over cow corner but didn't get the distance
Cut with the spin, in front of backward point. Was a touch short, SKY stood leg side of the ball and got his hands speeding through
Very short, 84ks ball sits up. SKY flat-bats it to the left of Omarzai at long-on, he slides through and that allows the second
Change of line from Chahal, gets it along the off-side tramline. SKY stands in his spot and reaches out for the cut, bottom hand comes off, ball goes to backward point
94ks fullish ball on leg, flat trajectory. Flicked to long-on
Sweeps the full ball from outside off through deep midwicket

Short fine was in, so SKY goes with the fine launched sweep. Got inside the line of the leg-stump length ball, SKY then got on one leg and got the bat swinging from above the right shoulder, through long-on and back over the other shoulder. He does that to pacers generally, now to spin too
Vyshak goes wider to beat him. Another full ball, Tilak's stride doesn't go outside off, so he reaches out and tries to drive through cover
Glorious lofted off-drive, Tilak's balance was perfect, he held his shape nicely too. 141ks full ball on fourth
Helped fine again, on the bounce to deep fine leg again. Vyshak going back to the slower one, on a length at fifth stump. SKY was across and mostly square-on, tried to sweep it on the rise
Beamer, called no ball straight away. Vyshak picks some sawdust before walking back. 137ks full toss slipped out around chest-height, Tilak jumped for the cut, under-edged it towards point

Helped fine, Jamieson has to take a couple of hurried steps to the left and maintain his balance after catching the ball on the bounce. Was a length ball well outside off, SKY got on one knee and swept it above his shoulder
Wide and full, driven to mid-off for a quick single. 146ks. Tilak was deep in the crease and was on fourth stump early
Jadeja-esque slap over the bowler. The bat turned inwards as he hit it but the timing was good enough. Was a fifth-stump length ball with pace on
A bit of width on the length ball, no turn, cut hard to backward point
Punches the length ball off the back foot, to the bowler
Full and loopy on fourth, swept hard to deep midwicket.
Fuller side of length at the stumps, swept to deep square leg
Fullish on off, a bit of turn on the legbreak. Defended to cover
Wide on a fullish length, floated up, it's square driven off the back foot to deep point

Vyshak's lack of pace does Bairstow in. Third knuckle ball in a row. Scrambles the seam to. Was a length ball around fifth, Bairstow premeditated, went across and tried to scoop it. Had no pace to work with, floated it off the back glove to the keeper.
Another knuckle ball, was much shorter. Fifth-stump line. Bairstow shapes for the pull, then tries to shift into the ramp. Misses
Shortish ball doesn't rise, finishes just over stump height. Bairstow stopped his pull midway, ball spun off the toe, through mid-on, and somehow they pinch two. Was a knuckle ball
Wide on a length, square driven to deep point
Not far of midwicket, who leapt to the right, and then the batters took on Arshdeep who ran to the left from long-on. Throw is decent but they make two. Was a short ball that was pulled
Wide and full, Tilak slashes and misses. He confers with Bairstow to check if it was too wide. No review
Flicked off the back foot through square leg. Short ball rose around rib-height, didn't look pacy off the pitch
Another bouncer, this is around top-of-shoulder height. Pulled from outside off to deep midwicket

Bumper, not given wide. Bairstow says 'it's wide', Tilak runs in and MI do review. That landed on fourth and finished over leg. Bairstow was almost fully upright as he left it, looked well above head on slow-mo replay. His head's 1.85 metres, ball went 2.04 metres
Slot ball has been slugged over midwicket. Bairstow moving to off stump and opening himself up by clearing his front leg. Swiped horizontally, around the thighs, to send the offcutter sailing
Length on leg, looks to slog sweep it square. Misses, ball deflects off the pad to the off side
Pulls the shortish ball to deep midwicket
Whipped over the infield. Got the low full toss on off through midwicket by taking a step back in the crease and checking his shot
Short again, looked slow. 110ks. Bairstow jumps leg side and pulls to deep square leg. He has a word with Tilak if it was too many bouncers for the over. Nothing from the umps
Very short and it gets spongy bounce. That landed around off and went well above head-height over middle and leg. 112ks
Length at the stumps, clipped through square leg
Not that short, pulled to deep-backward square on the bounce. Back of lengther on top of middle looked slow
Slower bouncer. Bairstow stays leg side of the ball and reaches up to drag the pull, top edges it through backward square.
So Bairstow tries to reverse paddle, had to adjust late but the wide slow full toss dips and beats the bat.
Length on fourth, dabbed towards point
Another top-edged pull, this flies over the keeper. Around shoulder height, Bairstow did judge the pace properly but couldn't cover the angle as it went away through fifth.

Hurried on the pull... and the top edge lands safely. Deep-backward square had to run towards fine leg, it landed halfway into the outfield. Was a short ball around chest-height that Tilak tried to hit square. Bottom hand came off upon impact
Slower one dug deep into the pitch, Bairstow pulls it to deep-backward square.
Cover's packed but Bairstow finds the gap. Got it to the right of the squarest of the infielders there. Was an overpitched fifth-stump ball that he splashed at a catchable height
Shortish at the stumps, 134ks, pulled to deep-backward square
Down leg. Looked like that brushed the pad as Tilak tried to flick it. The full ball was taken by the keeper. Ultra-Edge confirms that did brush pad
Bairstow toes a slog sweep to deep-backward square. 118ks ball on the fuller side of length, angling away through fourth
Length on leg, 134ks. Seams in and hits just above pad, falls on the off side of the pitch and rolls away. Batters charge through for the quick single
Fuller side of length on fourth, driven to mid-on. Slightly extended follow-through, but the bottom hand came off late
Taken at mid-on, they take a single. 129ks low full toss around seventh, Tilak stood in front of the stumps and reached out for the heave. Found Arshdeep for a high catch
Smoked over long-on... and it's a no-ball. Tilak charged at the cross-seamer on a length, got the room as it angled away outside off, and had a horizontal heave.
Chipped through square leg, deep fielder runs to the right to stop it. Very full ball, 128ks, angling into leg

Stoinis is thumping his chest, yelling c'mon boys, they're on alright! 132ks length ball seamed in a touch, was coming around off, Rohit picked it up with a flick but found deep-backward square. It went off the bottom of the bat, rose around top-of-pad height
Pumped over his head. Straight bat, through the three-quarter length ball angling in at the stumps. No movement
Scramble seam on a hard length outside off, Bairstow looks to upper cut and misses. It bounced more than he expected.

Short third runs back... and drops it, Omarzai reached it but was still on the move. His body was facing the crowd, he was looking up and tried to take it in front of his chest. Don't think he laid hand. Was a wide length ball that kept swinging away, Rohit tried to flay it over point, got it off the bottom-half
Bairstow charges and Jamieson bungs it short, over the stumps, pulled along the ground to deep-backward square
Picked up aerially, it's a pull-plus-sweep. Swivels and follows through till shoulder height, ball sails over square leg for a 79-metre six
Touch too straight, helped fine with a flick. Wadhera charges to the right from deep-backward square to stop it
A bit of away swing on the length ball on fourth, Rohit defends it to the bowler's left and takes off
Quick single to mid-off's right, he had to slide and throw in one motion. Sign that the grass isn't too wet there. Was a full ball on off that was punched with a mostly straight bat
Goes for the inswinging yorker, gets a low full toss on off. Bairstow drives it to mid-on for a quick single
Swings down leg. Late and sharp movement. Bairstow danced down and looked to flick the length ball, tried to get it fine.
Length on fourth, decent bounce. Bairstow waits and taps it on its head. Into the ground, towards gully it goes
Stump to stump. Fullis length. Lands leg after swinging away a touch, finishes on off, Bairstow blocks towards cover point
This one actually swung away, left-armers don't generally do that. Slight back of a length lands on fourth and goes away, Rohit gets upright and taps it towards point
Middled block to cover. Slightly away from the body, soft hands. Fullish on fifth, a bit of swing in

Shreyas Iyer has just fired Punjab Kings to their first final in 11 years with a knock of tremendous class! Iyer barely breaks a smile after he's launched this slot ball over long-on! Ashwani looks to go full and wide and Iyer hits him for the fourth six of the over to finish this chase in style. MI had never lost defending 200-plus, and now they've been knocked out doing so with an over to spare! And it's been a clinical chase from Punjab Kings!
Ashwani sticks to his guns with the wide ball plan, and this time does overshoot it. Umpire calls it wide immediately!

Full and wide, Iyer chases it and can't connect. Now he reviews for a wide! Third umpire says the wide guideline had moved because his stance was outside off. And the ball went within that line so it's a dot ball in the end

Shreyas is finishing it off in this over! Gets well across his stumps as Ashwani look for the wide ball plan again. The ball ends up in his arc and he dumps it over cow corner! What a stunning knock this has been from Shreyas Iyer!

Ashwani goes for another wide yorker and beats Iyer! Bairstow appeals, it's not really of interest to the umpire. But MI, probably in desperation, review! Only to see that the ball had bounced after the bat so they don't even bother with Ultra Edge
Free hit goes flying! Absolutely blasted over extra cover! Full and wide, Iyer gets across and bludgeons it! Two sixes off the first two legal balls of this over! Are PBKS in the final?
Ashwani responds with a full and wide ball angled across him, Iyer goes across to squeeze it out but is beaten. They appeal for caught behind, but are met with the no-ball siren! Free hit coming up!
Hoicked over long-on! You don't bowl slot balls to him now! Iyer gets in position and launches Ashwani over long-on. Massive!
Backs away as Bumrah goes full on the stumps, squeezed out through point for a single to end the over. Eight runs off it and Bumrah finishes with figures of 0-40 after going for 20 in his first over!
Back of length delivery outside off seams in. Stoinis drops it in front to his left and gets a quick single
Another yorker gone wrong, but Bumrah gets away with just conceding a single. This is into the body and flicked away to deep midwicket
Low full toss, but Iyer can only drive to cover

Shreyas Iyer you beauty! Jasprit Bumrah bowls a yorker, and he gets a boundary off it! Bumrah nails the yorker and Iyer jams the bat down with the open face again and gets it past short third! Oh, brilliant stuff
Looks for the yorker around off, Stoinis squeezes it out through cover for a single
This time he gets it fine enough! Yorker outside off and he jams his bat down with an open face. Goes past the keeper and races away!
Full and angled across, Shreyas opens the face to run it fine to short third. No single on offer

Low full toss outside off, Shashank drives it towards mid-on and takes off. There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end but it looks like Shashank was in safe. Scratch that, he was well short! Another wicket falls! Hardik Pandya nails the direct hit from mid-on and he looks stoic as ever even as his team-mates congratulate him. Shashank should have been quicker there, and now he has to walk back
Full and closer to off this time. Iyer again steers it fine on the off side but this time can't get it through the fielders

Smartly played! Shreyas shows he's not all about power, but also clever as ever! This is full and angled across him, he opens the face and just threads the gap between short third and backward point! 27-ball fifty up for the PBKS skipper!
Full on leg, Shashank is happy to get the well-set Shreyas Iyer on strike
Shreyas Iyer goes big! Too full, too straight and he plays a lovely pickup shot over fine leg and dumps it past the boundary rope! The wicket has fallen, but PBKS get 16 runs off the over!
Full on middle, clipped wide of mid-on for a quick single

Wide yorker does the trick! Is that the game? Wadhera senses he has to go after it but all he does is slice it in the air. Santner at cover tracks back and holds on. He falls two short of what would have been a well-deserved fifty, and MI have suddenly grabbed the momentum back. Ashwani didn't quite get the yorker full enough but got it wide enough that Wadhera had to chase it and couldn't get the elevation and distance he would have needed. His excellent display continues!
Full and angled across him, Iyer whips it in the air in front of square. Deep square runs to his left and deep midwicket is also converging but it lands short of them
Slower ball, short outside off. Wadhera waits on it and pulls it out to deep square leg
Now Ashwani goes for the yorker. Nails the length, but not the line as it slides down leg
What. A. Shot! Ashwani lumbers in and bowls it in the slot outside off and Wadhera lofts it straight down the ground! Goes high in the air, but also far enough to land in front of the sight screen!
Bumrah errs with a full toss down leg, Wadhera looks to flick it and gets bat on it and Bumrah gets away as that goes towards long leg. Just five off this over!
Yorker on off, swung away to deep midwicket's left and Iyer just gets a single. This one was fired in at 144kph
Looks for the yorker but just misses his length, Iyer hits a good flick, but it's straight to the midwicket fielder
Bumrah with a 140kph yorker on off, Wadhera digs it out, chipping it to long-on on the bounce
Wadhera has a swipe across the line as Bumrah digs it into the pitch outside off. The ball seamed away and Wadhera was early into the pitch. Lets out a cry of frustration on missing that
Smashed past him! Low full toss around off, Wadhera hits it straight back. Bumrah tried to get his hands on it but it just goes past his fingers. Long-on comes across to stop the boundary
Full on middle and leg, clipped to deep midwicket and PBKS finish with 14 runs this over
Now Boult slides one full and down leg
Nothing lucky about that! Full outside off and Wadhera punches it aerially in the gap between mid-off and cover!

Leading edge flies over short third! MI enjoyed some lucky edges, and now it's PBKS' turn! Full around middle, seaming away a touch. Wadhera looks to whip it away leg side but gets the leading edge and clears the short third fielder!
On a length around middle, whipped away to deep midwicket
Dug into the pitch on leg and angled across him, Iyer pulls it in front of deep square leg on the bounce
Full toss on leg, flicked in front of square for a single
Topley gets away with a full toss there! Full toss outside off and Iyer looks to drive and gets an edge but it bounces on its way to Bairstow
Topley sneaks in a wide yorker that Iyer can't squeeze out on the off side!
Hat-trick of sixes! Overpitched again, just around off, Iyer stands still and lofts it handsomely straight down the ground
Back-to-back sixes! PBKS need a big over and Iyer is trying to deliver that. Overpitched outside off and Iyer picks the bones out of that as he lofts it well over long-on!
Deposited into the stands! Takes on a slot ball and heaves it over backward square!
Full outside off, flicked through midwicket but they only get a single
Full outside off, flicked out to long-on for a single. 20 runs off his first over, this was more Bumrah-esque with just seven runs off it, and two 144kph yorkers thrown in the mix
Welcomes Shreyas with a 144kph yorker on off! But Iyer is up to the task and manages to squeeze it out towards point for a single
On a length around off, tapped square on the off side for a single
Very full around off, Wadhera manages to squeeze it back over the non-striker and they pick up two more
Full around off, fended to cover
Starts with a length ball outside off, Wadhera runs it down wide of deep third for a brace
Closes out the over well. Low full toss around off, clipped square for a single
Beats the edge now! Goes fuller and quick this time and Wadhera pokes at it and sees the ball fly past his edge
Slower bouncer outside off, left alone by Wadhera
Low full toss on off, Wadhera flicks it behind square leg and gets two as deep square leg gets across
Slower bouncer outside off beats Wadhera's attempted pull
Full around off, Shreyas flicks it out through midwicket for two.

Boult drops it at deep fine leg, he ran to the left and might have slipped late. Got both fingers on it but parried it onto the boundary. Slower bouncer almost worked again for Hardik. He found the top edge off the pull
Wide on a length, carved to sweeper cover,
Shreyas was ready to leave the slower bouncer, then realised he was beside it and could held it away. Got the bat behind him and ramped it over the area between keeper and first slip
Fullish outside off, square driven to deep point
Hooked from head-height, clears the backward-square boundary. Short ball was well directed, Wadhera stood in the crease and swung across cleanly
Length on leg, flicked from the back foot to long-on

Deep midwicket is a few metres inside the boundary and this sails above him. Dhir came running in and misjudged it completely, Monga says from the ground. That was a teaser from Santner too, was a slow shortish ball and Wadhera pulled it flat
Flat length ball on fourth, driven to long-off
Full on off, worked to long-on
Makes room and gets followed by a length ball, punched to long-off
Big appeal for lbw, looked like it was going down leg. Hardik checks, 'hit the bat' is the chat from the fielders. Was a full ball that Wadhera tried to sweep
Length on leg, defended to long-on
Length on off, 136ks, punched to cover

Only a couple of MI players appeal for caught behind, it's subdued.... but it's given! Anticlimactic almost. Inglis reviews quick. He went for the pull, the ball was close to the top edge. Ultra-Edge registers a small spike but that's enough. Offcutter at 121ks landed very short, was rising around head-height. Went through fifth stump, Inglis tried to drag it fine.
Length on fourth, defended to the right of point
Length on middle, flicked to deep fine leg. 133ks
Hard length at the stumps, worked off the back foot to midwicket
Bumper it is. Beats the pull, hits the side of the helmet and pops to the keeper. Was a cutter that came in sharply
Dances down and gets to the pitch but doesn't time it. Toes a drive that goes to long-on on the bounce
Loopy stock ball beats the reverse, keeper doesn't collect properly. Inglis was beside the line of the ball and had the bat facing the keeper, wanted to go fine
Dances down and drives past cover, the sweeper runs right o keep it to two. Inglis went down early and wasn't up to the pitch as Santner adjusted his length
Loopy and fullish outside off, Shreyas' bottom hand comes off as he drives to deep cover. 95ks but it looked slow
Flat length ball on middle and leg, punched off the back foot to long-on
Full on middle, driven to long-off
Inglis smacks it over mid-off. Small stride forward, gets real low and opens the back shoulder to power the drive over mid-off. Fullish ball on fourth wasn't a half-volley
Punches the length ball on fourth to cover
Yes, no, and Shreyas runs back and dives. Tilak went left and throw in one motion. Inglis called no early enough as it turned out. Was a length ball he dabbed with an open face
Shreyas goes deep in the crease, lifts his front leg and pulls it with ease. Over square leg. Was a back of length ball that bounced a touch low
Length on off, defended to backward point

Ashwani comes in and strikes first ball, an expensive Bumrah over might not look as bad now. 133ks scrambled-seam ball into the pitch. Angled in towards fourth, Arya tried to club it across the line, got a top edge to Pandya, running in from mid-off.
Just over deep third! Tall Topley leapt high, tried to take a high catch with his left hand but it cleared him. Inglis top-edged that cut and survived anyway.
Inglis is taking Bumrah down, he uses the angle and flicks it to the right of square leg. 133ks fullish ball on middle, closes the face and plays from the crease
Bouncer on fifth, Inglis looks to pull it through square leg. Misses.
Inglis swings cleanly, goes five rows past long-on. Fuller side of length on fifth, a bit of movement in off the pitch.
That stuck in the pitch. Inglis was early into the cover drive, spooned it on the bounce to cover point. 125ks three-quarter length on fifth
And Inglis gets a freebie. Maybe not. The length ball was angling in towards middle, he flicked it through midwicket. But the bat was going more towards mid-on,
Length over leg, Inglis gets inside the line and flicks to deep fine leg
Length on fourth, tapped to deep point

Slower one is launched high. It's in the air for a while, mid-on runs back and nearly makes the boundary by the time it landed past the boundary board. Back-of-hand slower ball on a full length coming in towards the stumps, Arya waited before flicking it up
Wide and shortish, Priyansh top-edges a cut this time. Clears the infield. Deep point runs to the left to stop it
Wide on a length, tries to cut. Got it off the bottom-edge to point
Misses his line. Fullish down leg, flicked behind square. Clears the infield, that's all he needed
Crowd catch to cover. Very full ball on fourth, driven into the ground and it then popped to the fielder
Not in control, gets away with it. Feet were jammed as Inglis tried to drive the fullish ball on fourth, down the ground. Got a thick outside edge to forward point.
Not that short but Inglis pulls over midwicket. Was a length ball around top of middle, Inglis isn't that tall and it works out for him. Didn't even have to crouch much
Gamble pays off for Inglis, crawled across to the off side early. Got inside the line of the length ball at his hip, went through with the scoop and got it fine of long leg running to the right
Late swing back in, good bounce too. Off a hard length, lands on leg and hits Inglis on the back pad as he was jumping. He tried to defend straight

Topley running back from short fine does well to avoid a collision and hold on. Santner, from deep-backward square, was running in the same direction too. Don't think there was a call from Topley, he reached forward and held on while decelerating. Was a 121ks shortish ball at the body that Prabhsimran tried pulling. He got a top edge by being early into the shot
Flicked aerially off the back foot, not much of a follow-through but the timing was bang on. Got the length ball sailing over midwicket
Past the edge. Priyansh tries to drive on the up through cover, the length ball on fifth sticks into the pitch a bit. Was wider than the batter thought too
Cut nicely, fielder does even better. Bawa charges to the left from deep third, dives over his shoulder and pulls it well in. Was a wide length ball that was square driven on the top of the bounce
Length over leg, flicked to deep fine leg
Blocked while bouncing. Played with a straight bat, ball went off the sticker towards point, Back of length ball was going over middle
Good bounce from a fuller side of length. Going away through fourth, Prabhsimran guides it to backward point
Length on middle, flicked to midwicket
Cut to backward point on the bounce. Shortish ball just outside off, Prabhsimran getting some whiplash off that shot
Back of length over off, defended off the back foot to point
Driven well but finds cover. He was standing close and it came low to him. Was a wide fullish ball that was played with a horizontal bat
Whipped with the swing, taken off middle stump over square leg. Was very full, played completely across the line by Prabhsimran
A bit of swing away. Fullish on fourth, patted with an open face to backward point's right. Tilak dives to stop it
